title: continuity-checkpoint-v1
description: L2 immutable checkpoint envelope written by cdad_continuity.py begin/checkpoint and verified by resume (003-004, P1/P7, D2/D11).

record.description: 003-007 (P6/D5): which command wrote this checkpoint body/link — `begin` or `checkpoint`. Absent in legacy bodies (pre-003-007), the legacy discriminator (O-1).

body_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical body; the body is content-addressed under continuity/bodies/<body_sha256>.json.

prev_checkpoint_sha256.description: body_sha256 of the preceding link, or null for the first checkpoint.

references.description: L3 references to existing history, each with the digest of its real content. 003-007: each entry also carries the resolved `class` (contract/living) and, when declared, the `fields` projection (D2/D4).

class.description: 003-007 (P3/D2): the DECLARED reference class; `contract` blocks on divergence, `living` only informs. Absent/unknown falls closed to `contract`.

fields.description: 003-007 (P4/BL-3): top-level JSON keys the frozen digest projects over (canonical V2 projection). Absent → the complete file bytes are digested.

bytes.description: Size in bytes of the canonical projection (<= max_bytes).

no_op.description: true when begin found an identical head and persisted nothing (P3).
